datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

model Tenant {
  id           String        @id @default(uuid())
  name         String
  slug         String        @unique
  domain       String?       @unique
  currencyCode String        @default("USD")
  timezone     String        @default("UTC")
  plan         String        @default("ENTERPRISE")
  createdAt    DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime      @updatedAt

  users        User[]
  products     Product[]
  collections  Collection[]
  locations    Location[]
  orders       Order[]
  customers    Customer[]
  discounts    Discount[]
  webhooks     Webhook[]
  metafields   Metafield[]
  metaobjects  Metaobject[]

  @@map("tenants")
}

model User {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId     String
  email        String
  passwordHash String
  firstName    String?
  lastName     String?
  role         String   @default("MERCHANT_ADMIN")
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  tenant       Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([tenantId, email])
  @@index([tenantId])
  @@map("users")
}

model Product {
  id              String           @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId        String
  title           String
  handle          String
  description     String
  descriptionHtml String?
  vendor          String           @default("Default")
  productType     String           @default("General")
  status          String           @default("ACTIVE")
  tags            String[]         @default([])
  images          String[]         @default([])
  options         Json             @default("[]")
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt

  tenant          Tenant           @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variants        ProductVariant[]
  collectionItems ProductCollectionItem[]

  @@unique([tenantId, handle])
  @@index([tenantId, status])
  @@map("products")
}

model ProductVariant {
  id                String           @id @default(uuid())
  productId         String
  title             String
  sku               String
  barcode           String?
  price             Decimal          @default(0.0)
  compareAtPrice    Decimal?
  weight            Decimal?
  requiresShipping  Boolean          @default(true)
  selectedOptions   Json             @default("[]")
  image             String?
  createdAt         DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime         @updatedAt

  product           Product          @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  inventoryLevels   InventoryLevel[]
  orderLineItems    OrderLineItem[]

  @@unique([productId, sku])
  @@index([productId])
  @@map("product_variants")
}

model Location {
  id                   String           @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId             String
  name                 String
  address1             String
  city                 String
  province             String?
  country              String
  zip                  String
  fulfillsOnlineOrders Boolean          @default(true)
  createdAt            DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime         @updatedAt

  tenant               Tenant           @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  inventoryLevels      InventoryLevel[]
  fulfillments         Fulfillment[]

  @@index([tenantId])
  @@map("locations")
}

model InventoryLevel {
  id           String         @id @default(uuid())
  variantId    String
  locationId   String
  available    Int            @default(0)
  reserved     Int            @default(0)
  onHand       Int            @default(0)
  updatedAt    DateTime       @updatedAt

  variant      ProductVariant @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  location     Location       @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([variantId, locationId])
  @@index([variantId])
  @@index([locationId])
  @@map("inventory_levels")
}

model Collection {
  id          String                  @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId    String
  title       String
  handle      String
  description String?
  image       String?
  rules       Json?
  createdAt   DateTime                @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime                @updatedAt

  tenant      Tenant                  @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  products    ProductCollectionItem[]

  @@unique([tenantId, handle])
  @@index([tenantId])
  @@map("collections")
}

model ProductCollectionItem {
  productId    String
  collectionId String

  product      Product    @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([productId, collectionId])
  @@map("product_collection_items")
}

model Customer {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId       String
  email          String
  firstName      String?
  lastName       String?
  phone          String?
  totalSpent     Decimal   @default(0.0)
  ordersCount    Int       @default(0)
  tags           String[]  @default([])
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  tenant         Tenant    @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  addresses      Address[]
  orders         Order[]

  @@unique([tenantId, email])
  @@index([tenantId])
  @@map("customers")
}

model Address {
  id         String    @id @default(uuid())
  customerId String?
  firstName  String?
  lastName   String?
  company    String?
  address1   String
  address2   String?
  city       String
  province   String?
  country    String
  zip        String
  phone      String?
  isDefault  Boolean   @default(false)
  createdAt  DateTime  @default(now())

  customer   Customer? @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("addresses")
}

model Order {
  id                 String          @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId           String
  orderNumber        Int
  name               String
  email              String
  financialStatus    String          @default("PAID")
  fulfillmentStatus  String          @default("UNFULFILLED")
  currencyCode       String          @default("USD")
  subtotalPrice      Decimal
  totalTax           Decimal         @default(0.0)
  totalShipping      Decimal         @default(0.0)
  totalDiscounts     Decimal         @default(0.0)
  totalPrice         Decimal
  customerId         String?
  shippingAddress    Json?
  billingAddress     Json?
  note               String?
  tags               String[]        @default([])
  createdAt          DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime        @updatedAt

  tenant             Tenant          @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  customer           Customer?       @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id])
  lineItems          OrderLineItem[]
  fulfillments       Fulfillment[]

  @@unique([tenantId, orderNumber])
  @@index([tenantId, financialStatus])
  @@index([tenantId, fulfillmentStatus])
  @@map("orders")
}

model OrderLineItem {
  id                String          @id @default(uuid())
  orderId           String
  variantId         String?
  title             String
  variantTitle      String?
  sku               String?
  quantity          Int
  price             Decimal
  totalDiscount     Decimal         @default(0.0)
  fulfillmentStatus String          @default("UNFULFILLED")

  order             Order           @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variant           ProductVariant? @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id])

  @@index([orderId])
  @@map("order_line_items")
}

model Fulfillment {
  id              String    @id @default(uuid())
  orderId         String
  locationId      String?
  status          String    @default("SUCCESS")
  trackingCompany String?
  trackingNumber  String?
  trackingUrl     String?
  createdAt       DateTime  @default(now())

  order           Order     @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  location        Location? @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id])

  @@index([orderId])
  @@map("fulfillments")
}

model Discount {
  id         String    @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId   String
  code       String
  type       String    @default("PERCENTAGE")
  value      Decimal
  usageCount Int       @default(0)
  startsAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  endsAt     DateTime?
  createdAt  DateTime  @default(now())

  tenant     Tenant    @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([tenantId, code])
  @@index([tenantId])
  @@map("discounts")
}

model Webhook {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId  String
  topic     String
  endpoint  String
  secret    String
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tenant    Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([tenantId, topic])
  @@map("webhooks")
}

model Metafield {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId  String
  ownerType String
  ownerId   String
  namespace String
  key       String
  type      String   @default("single_line_text_field")
  value     String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  tenant    Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([tenantId, ownerType, ownerId, namespace, key])
  @@index([tenantId, ownerType, ownerId])
  @@map("metafields")
}

model Metaobject {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  tenantId   String
  type       String
  handle     String
  fields     Json
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  tenant     Tenant   @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([tenantId, type, handle])
  @@index([tenantId, type])
  @@map("metaobjects")
}

    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "NodeNext",
    "moduleResolution": "NodeNext",

    "strict": true,
